name: Azor (son of Eliakim)
title: Link in the genealogy of Jesus
summary: Azor is the son of Eliakim and the father of Zadok in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Matthew. He belongs to the third group of fourteen generations, from the Babylonian exile to Christ, and is known only from this list. The name is the Greek Azor and has nothing to do with the Canaanite city of Hazor.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus
keyEvents.description: Matthew names Azor as the son of Eliakim and the father of Zadok.
